---

## 1. What Does ManageMyWeb Develop?
ManageMyWeb focuses on custom 3D e-commerce website development—turning standard flat product grids on Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom storefronts into walkable 3D virtual showrooms that run inside normal desktop and mobile web browsers without app downloads.

Separately, ManageMyWeb provides Managed Website Operations for e-commerce brands needing technical reliability: cloud hosting management, domain & DNS tracking, SSL hygiene, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, off-site backups, speed maintenance, and routine storefront edits.

---

## 2. How the Prototype & Build Process Works
1. **Discovery & Catalog Review**: Merchants share their store link, commerce platform, and top products to feature.
2. **Working 3D Prototype Demo**: Our team builds an interactive browser preview showcasing selected products so the brand can evaluate usability on phone and desktop first.
3. **Integration & Launch**: Catalog data, variants, and cart routing connect with your existing Shopify or WooCommerce checkout where supported, paired with accessible HTML fallback copy and consent-aware analytics.

---

## 3. Platform Integration Summaries
- **Shopify (`https://www.managemyweb.co/shopify-3d-store`)**: Syncs product titles, prices, variants, and inventory via Storefront APIs and routes carts into native Shopify checkout where compatible with active cart apps.
- **WooCommerce (`https://www.managemyweb.co/woocommerce-3d-store`)**: Offloads compressed 3D assets to edge CDN infrastructure while preserving existing WordPress plugins, Stripe/PayPal/regional gateways, and WooCommerce orders.

---

## 4. Technical SEO & Accessibility Commitments
- Meaningful headlines, product summaries, FAQs, and primary CTAs live in normal semantic HTML outside WebGL/canvas layers.
- Motion preferences (`prefers-reduced-motion`), keyboard focus navigation, and low-power static preview fallbacks are supported cleanly.
- GA4 and Clarity analytics respect Google Consent Mode v2 user preferences without tracking PII in conversion events.
